title: EngagementInsightType - Tooling API
description: Represents the configuration for engagement insight types for voice and video call insights. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

ActivatedDateTime.description: The timestamp when the insight type was activated.

AdditionalConfig.description: The additional configuration information specific to the insight type. For example, timing configurations for time-based insights and prompt-based configurations for generative insights.

Category.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Category.description: The category of the insight type. Possible values are: CUSTOM—Custom insights are created by the admin. SYSTEM—System insights are provided out-of-the-box by Salesforce. The default value is CUSTOM.

ChannelType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ChannelType.description: The engagement channel used to generate the insight. Possible values are: Emails VideoCalls VoiceCalls The default value is VoiceCalls.

Description.description: The description of the insight type.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name for the EngagementInsightType object.

ExternalIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalIdentifier.description: The ID generated for each insight type.

InsightModel.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
InsightModel.description: The computational model that the user selects to generate the insight. Possible values are: FOUNDTIONAL—Foundational GENERATIVE—Generative KEYWORD—Keyword SITUATIONAL—Situational TIME_BASED—Time-Based The default value is KEYWORD.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: The language used in the insight type.

SpeakerType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SpeakerType.description: Specifies if the participant is internal (internal rep), external (customer), or either (not sure). It indicates the 'Said by' field in the UI. Possible values are: EITHER EXTERNAL INTERNAL NONE The default value is INTERNAL.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the insight type. Possible values are: ENABLED USER_DISABLED The default value is ENABLED.

SupportedLanguageList.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SupportedLanguageList.description: The list of languages supported for the insight type.

UsageType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
UsageType.description: The industry where the insight type is applicable. Possible values are: SALES SALES_SERVICE SERVICE The default value is SALES.
